scope: Long-URI task fallback; no host application/UI execution by this agent
rootCause: Clipboard fallback removed the prompt required by WorkBuddy task parser, so action=start was rejected as missing-required.
fixedBehavior: Keep a short nonempty task prefill with handoff locator while preserving the complete prompt in clipboard. User replaces prefill and manually sends. No payloadId protocol was invented.

designRules.Reading-02: Complete long prompt remains available without truncation; URI contains only placeholder and locator.
designRules.Surface-03: Native confirmation is concise and keeps explicit open/cancel choices; real GUI verification pending root.
designRules.Acceptance-01: 59 regression tests, native typecheck, generated bridge and diff checks passed.
designRules.Acceptance-02: New packaged native dialog / workspace observations pending root; source and offline parser are not visual acceptance.
designRules.Acceptance-03: No cross-platform installation or Codex native conversation success claimed.
